beneficios: Helps break the pest and disease cycle.

evidencias: Days of bare soil/year (catalog): ~70 days.

Mar/2026), variable cost (≈COE)) = R$ 2,366/ha (yield CV 10%; bad year, p20 of the same 10-year window = 56 bags/ha → R$ 1,883/ha).

Wheat: 40 bags/ha (PAM Cascavel 2016–2025 trend projected to the next season; mean 40 bags/ha) × R$ 68.44/bag (SEAB/DERAL-PR, PR mean Nov/25 to Oct/26) − cost R$ 4,334/ha (CONAB Ponta Grossa-PR, winter 2025 (Nov/2025), variable cost (≈COE)) = R$ -1,566/ha (yield CV 20%; bad year, p20 of the same 10-year window = 33 bags/ha → R$ -2,041/ha).
Bonus in the following soybean: 1 bags/ha × R$ 120.14/bag = R$ 120/ha (straw/N and disease-cycle break, reference estimate).

Rotation total: R$ 920/ha/year; 2nd-season increment (without soybean, with the bonus): R$ -1,446/ha, on the scale S = R$ 2,366/ha (municipality soybean margin, min. 1,000); in a bad year (p20 yield): R$ -39/ha/year.

Income history of wheat in the municipality (realized margin, bags of soybean/ha): 2021: +8, 2022: -3, 2023: -6, 2024: -5, 2025: -18; mean -4.9; negative margin in 4 of 5. Source: IBGE PAM (municipality yield; realized PR price = value/production) and CONAB variable cost Londrina-PR of each season; in bags of soybean/ha (÷ realized soybean price in PR in the same year); without the bonus in the following soybean. Informative: not part of the score.

Water: in the critical phase (wheat heading/grain fill, sowing on 01/05), soil water met on average 99% of the demand; in 0 of 34 years it was below 70% (daily balance NASA POWER + SoilGrids soil, AWC 85 mm).
Frost (≤ 3 °C) at wheat flowering (15/08–30/09): 12 of 34 years (35%), NASA POWER 1991–2024, ~50 km cell.

ZARC 2025/2026 (MAPA, risk table, rainfed), Cascavel: soybean on 15/10: indicated, risk 20% (100% of the soil classes; Port.375_de_26-06-2025); wheat on 01/05: indicated, risk 20% (100% of the soil classes; Port.440_de_29-10-2025).
Market in Western Paraná: medium; cooperatives and mills, with lower liquidity than corn (estimate to validate with local cooperatives/dealers).
lacunas: AWC by pedotransfer (Saxton & Rawls), may be wrong on tropical oxisols.
